verdict.rationale: Docs mention automating the tailnet via infrastructure-as-code, webhooks and other integrations, plus a documented CLI, implying an API layer exists beyond the UI (tailscale-docs-12, tailscale-probe-3). However, there is no evidence of full UI/API parity, no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s on probes), and community feedback notes friction with API usage such as 60-day key expirations, suggesting the API is a secondary, less polished path rather than a complete substitute for the UI.
